subject.title: fix(discord): default account env fallback when accounts.default.token is blank

question: Should a blank `channels.discord.accounts.default.token` fall through to top-level/`DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN`, or remain an explicit opt-out that blocks inherited credentials?
rationale: Both choices affect existing credential-selection semantics for the default Discord account, and the repository treats auth/provider fallback behavior as compatibility-sensitive.

options.title: Align fallback across all Discord token surfaces
options.body: Accept default-account blank-token fallback only after runtime, inspect, setup/status, and tests share the same invariant and the PR includes real behavior proof.

options.title: Preserve blank-token opt-out
options.body: Keep blank account tokens as an explicit inheritance stop and fix the config merge or selector that injects an empty default-account stub instead.

options.title: Accept runtime-only behavior
options.body: Land the resolver-only change and knowingly leave status/setup consistency to a follow-up, accepting temporary operator confusion risk.

recommendation.title: Align fallback across all Discord token surfaces
recommendation.body: Accept default-account blank-token fallback only after runtime, inspect, setup/status, and tests share the same invariant and the PR includes real behavior proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The current Discord resolver status behavior and SecretRef fallback contract route through joshavant's merged #76987 work.
